notes.title: Third Crisis: Neon Nights - v0.1 Demo Release!
notes.content:
The wait is finally over! 💜


Dive into a cyberpunk metropolis as the mercenary, Zoey Madison. Find a way to navigate the seductive and corrupt Neon City. Choose who to trust, what to desire, and how far you'll go. Are you in it for the pleasure? Or will you stay pure?‎


Play the demo today ♡
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3400350/Third_Crisis_Neon_Nights/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/207e70338c9b44c39f2654b173f8eee1b167dba5.png"]

Zoey's latest contract takes her to the Glowing Hole: a brothel in the Red Light District of Neon City. There are three distinct ways for Zoey to accomplish her task.



Plus... an especially perverted way to end it. 👀



Enjoy experiencing them all!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/dde3cbcd7710152b736a70447ded8f074dd8ba48.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/f300046add56758501126f3b107996a18d09e5da.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/793d826ac57cbd796d855499eb432424110f81fd.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/6f10a4004896b5bace74115fac491d5dbbf6cdeb.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/85b91f0ede9ad09e01e71ba7c3cd31957a17ee9f.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/207e70338c9b44c39f2654b173f8eee1b167dba5.png"]

We've put our hearts and souls into this release, utilizing everything we've learned from Third Crisis to completely blow our previous game out of the water. From animated overworld characters to fully voice-acted dialogue, this is truly an evolution of what you loved from Third Crisis and more.



We hope you enjoy this demo and stick around to see what the game looks like in the years to come!


Play the demo today ♡
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3400350/Third_Crisis_Neon_Nights/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/207e70338c9b44c39f2654b173f8eee1b167dba5.png"]

Lastly, we are actively developing the game, so make sure to hop onto our Discord if you want to follow our progress or chat with us!

Your feedback and support will help shape the ultimate cyberlust experience.

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/813f5c501e5e9155eba35e2e48f4af9ece689fd7.png"]

 
With Love,Anduo Games ♡

notes.title: Third Crisis: Neon Nights Steam Page is Live!
notes.content:
Welcome to the inception of a new age for Third Crisis.


This standalone game is a prequel to Third Crisis and takes place during its five-year timeskip, before Jenna reappears in Carceburg. It's been three years since the Third Crisis shook the world. And the Global Andro Government - GAG - now controls most of it.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/85b91f0ede9ad09e01e71ba7c3cd31957a17ee9f.png"]

The heroes are gone. And in the biggest city in the world, resourcefulness is the only way to survive.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/dde3cbcd7710152b736a70447ded8f074dd8ba48.png"]

Dive into Neon City is Zoey, a down-on-her-luck merc, and steer her down your preferred path. Piece together a living in the shady underbelly of one of the largest population centers in the world under GAG’s control.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/6f10a4004896b5bace74115fac491d5dbbf6cdeb.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/207e70338c9b44c39f2654b173f8eee1b167dba5.png"]
